comments.author: zetapulse
comments.text:
F…M…L…
Mr. Patrick, sir, I’d just like to say, your work freaks the shit outta me. Never has a single cartoonist stunned me so many times. Thought I’d at least thank you for that.

I’m still going through your archives, but I’ve noticed the sporadic updates to your comics. Though I’m yet to feel dissatisfaction from reaching a dead end in any of your stories, I still dread the day I have to sit & wait a few months to read a chunk of your updates.

Can’t wait to see the BOB & BOB movie. I may not be big on commenting, but I assure you, I’ll be here.
